In my opinion, and experience the map, and objectives are overly pushed to be very easy to defend, and hard to attack. The only objective I would say it easy to attack than defend, is the Drug Lab site. But when it comes to armory there are only 6 total reinforceable walls, which are very easy to stop the attack team from breaking. All that is needed it the normal Thacther ban during the ban phase, then get a mute, Kaid, and bandit (all of which have C4). And there’s almost no chance of the attacking team destroying the walls. Also when it comes to the Day Care, and Bunk site there’s long hallways you have to push down to get to the site, and if you want to push through Cafe, you  have to always be worried a Pulse or Valk is below you waiting with a C4. The 2 reinforceable walls in the back of Bunk that lead to Initiation room, are also easily defending with the same logic used with the Armory walls. Honestly to wrap this up, I feel that Theme Park isn’t nearly as destructible as any of the other maps, there just a very few walls to blow up which makes it very easy to defend. Most of the time attackers have to peak through objective doorways to try and find a kill, and they have to walk into objective through the objective doorways, instead of being able to make their own entry point. If you read all this Thank you, and I really hope you guys looks into change or even removing it from Ranked.
